skills.name: chat-on-device
skills.description: Walk a user through chatting with the on-device model: pre-flight device check, model choice, one-time download, then offline-capable chat on their own hardware.

skills.name: compare-models
skills.description: Compare the available models (SmolLM2 360M, Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B, Llama 3.2 1B, Phi-4 mini) by download size and speed trade-offs, and recommend one for a user's device.

skills.name: diagnose-device
skills.description: Use the diagnostics page to name the visitor's browser, OS, and graphics chip, and give per-device performance tips for local inference.
